title: Help
summary: The consumer Help hub uses the Help header, a search trigger, top tasks and short topic paths in comfortable prose.
compare: Help header has a Help tag, Search help and Your library, but no door tabs.
Top tasks use reader language and categories are organized by the task groups.
Comfortable prose is 16/26 and interactive phone controls remain usable.

designReview.reviewer: pkey-ux-reviewer (rendered consumer, developer and brand lenses)
designReview.verdict: Consumer phone review passed after the shared home display treatment was restored; task cards remain clear and touch-sized.

findings.issue: The Help home title inherited the 24/32 article heading instead of the home display step.
findings.resolution: Scoped home titles to 40/48 on desktop and 30/36 on phone, retaining the comfortable-prose body treatment.
